_comment: Default corporate governance preferences. These reflect widely-accepted best-practice standards. Override any key via 'python main.py preferences set KEY VALUE' or 'preferences learn'.

director_elections.comment_attendance: Vote AGAINST any director who attended fewer than 75% of board/committee meetings without valid reason
director_elections.comment_overboarding: CEOs sitting on >2 outside public boards; others sitting on >4 public boards
director_elections.comment_diversity: Vote AGAINST nominating committee chair if board is <20% women
director_elections.comment_independent_chair: Support shareholder proposals for independent board chair; vote AGAINST combined CEO/Chair unless strong lead independent director
director_elections.comment_audit_independence: Vote AGAINST audit committee members if non-independent auditor relationship exists
director_elections.comment_staggered_boards: Oppose classified/staggered boards — all directors should face annual re-election

executive_compensation.comment: Evaluate pay-for-performance alignment; scrutinize peer group selection and pay mix
executive_compensation.comment_pay_ratio: Vote AGAINST say-on-pay if CEO-to-median worker pay ratio exceeds 500x
executive_compensation.comment_repricing: Underwater option repricing without shareholder approval is unacceptable
executive_compensation.comment_parachutes: Vote AGAINST excessive severance agreements exceeding 3x base+bonus

auditor.comment: Routinely ratify auditor unless red flags; flag for review if auditor has served >10 years
auditor.comment_fees: Scrutinize if non-audit fees exceed 50% of audit fees (potential independence issue)

esg_shareholder_proposals.comment_climate: Support requests for TCFD-aligned climate risk reporting and emissions targets
esg_shareholder_proposals.comment_political: Support disclosure of corporate political spending and lobbying expenditures
esg_shareholder_proposals.comment_diversity_reporting: Support EEO-1 disclosure and board diversity reporting
esg_shareholder_proposals.comment_pay_equity: Support disclosure of gender and racial pay gap data

governance_proposals.comment_majority_voting: Support majority vote standard for director elections (vs. plurality)
governance_proposals.comment_poison_pills: Vote AGAINST shareholder rights plans (poison pills) without shareholder approval
governance_proposals.comment_classified: Support annual elections; oppose multi-year terms for directors
governance_proposals.comment_supermajority: Vote AGAINST supermajority vote requirements for routine matters

equity_plans.comment: Always escalate to human review — dilution impact needs personal assessment
equity_plans.comment_evergreen: Oppose plans with automatic annual share replenishment (evergreen)
equity_plans.comment_overhang: Flag plans where total potential dilution (overhang) exceeds 15% of shares outstanding

mergers_acquisitions.comment: Always escalate to human review — M&A decisions require personal judgment on deal terms
